page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg6.26xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at 2.5 GHz on x86_64 architecture. The server features 104 dedicated vCPUs managed via KVM hypervisor technology and comes equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.69 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

The hardware configuration contains no bundled local disk storage and zero GPU accelerators. External network connectivity is provided via a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With 104 dedicated vCPUs and a balanced memory allocation, this instance provides high core density for enterprise application backends, container orchestration hubs, web server clusters, and database management systems reliant on remote block storage.
